event.title: Belong announced $2.7M Seed
event.summary: Belong reported share that @belongrewards has raised $2.7M in Seed capital 🚀 Grateful to be backed by an incredible group of investors, including a16z Speedrun, Lakestar, Backwards Capital, and Prevail, alongside an outstanding group of angel operators and entrepreneurs.
